'''Gökhan Budak''' (1968 – 26 January 2013) was a Turkish [[professor]] of [[quantum physics]]. He was the [[Rector (education)|Rector]] of [[Bayburt University]] from 7 September 2012 to his death.

== Biography ==
Gökhan Budak was born in [[Olur]], [[Erzurum]]. He graduated first in his year with a B.S. degree from [[Ankara University|Ankara University Faculty of Language, History and Geography]] in 1989. He started his academic career as a research assistant in 1990. He became an [[assistant professor]] (''yardımcı doçent'') in 1996, an [[associate professor]] (''doçent'') in 2000 and a [[full professor]] in 2006.<ref name="hiswebsite">{{cite web |url=http://gokhanbudak.com/?page_id=12 |title= Özgeçmiş | publisher=Gokhanbudak.com |access-date=2013-02-05 |language=Turkish}}</ref>

He committed suicide by cutting his wrists and jumping from balcony of his house on 26 January 2013.<ref name="portal">{{cite news |title=Bayburt Üniversitesi Rektörü hayatını kaybetti |url=http://haber.sol.org.tr/kent-gundemleri/bayburt-universitesi-rektoru-hayatini-kaybetti-haberi-66955 |publisher=soL Portal |date=2013-01-26 |access-date=2013-02-05 |language=Turkish}}</ref> His funeral was held at both Bayburt University and Olur Merkez Mosque, and buried in Olur Cemetery on 27 January 2013.<ref name="cnnturk">{{cite news |title=İntihar eden rektör toprağa verildi |url=http://www.cnnturk.com/2013/guncel/01/27/intihar.eden.rektor.topraga.verildi/694116.0/index.html |publisher=CNNTurk.com |date=2013-01-27 |access-date=2013-02-05 |language=Turkish}}</ref>
